name: MIDI piano-roll
doc: Falling piano-roll note highway driven by audio spectral pitch bands and live MIDI note-on events, with a lit 4-octave keyboard and onset-reactive strike line.

palette.doc: maps pitch class and octave to note and key colors

speed.doc: fall speed of notes in rows per 60 Hz tick

threshold.doc: minimum energy required to trigger a falling note bar

perspective.doc: 3D highway tilt perspective (0 = flat vertical roll, 0.8 = deep arcade highway)

keyboard_h.doc: height of the piano keyboard at the bottom of the frame

glow.doc: HDR glow intensity for active notes, strike line, and lit keys

grid.doc: visibility of octave lanes and beat-synced horizontal grid lines
